Description.SourceString:
You have surely abandoned me, brothers, but I know the truth! Haha! The things I have seen! We accused the wrong thief! The Burning Spire may have roasted me, but from here I saw more than any of you. While you fools accused each other, I watched our fortune drift farther into the desert between you.

Keep walking! The desert will finish you as surely as it will finish me. Look at us, scattered across the desert with our fortune somewhere in the middle, and not one of you has the sense to see it! We shall arrive penniless at death’s door together, and I can’t wait to see the looks on your faces.
